journey.name: Gaps add suggestion
journey.description: Verifies that "Add to Wardrobe" on a common suggestion opens the add-item sheet pre-filled with that suggestion, in add mode rather than edit mode. Stops before the photo, which is external input. Start state: fresh install with no API key configured.

actions.action: Tap the "GAPS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Gaps screen shows the "What's missing" heading and a "Polo shirt" suggestion card.
Verify the suggestion detail sheet is shown with an "Add to Wardrobe" button.
Verify the add-item sheet is shown with the "Add new item" title — not "Edit item" — and the name field pre-filled with "Polo shirt".
Verify the category is pre-selected as "Tops" and the subcategory as "Polo".
Verify the save button reads "Save to wardrobe" — not "Save Changes" — and is disabled, because no photo has been chosen yet.
